title: Spiced Indian Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian dish made with basmati rice, marinated chicken, and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the biryani masala and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the marinated chicken and cook until browned.
Add the basmati rice and glassy water to the pan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
Fluff the rice with a fork and garnish with luscious long-grain rice.
Serve hot with a dollop of fermented yogurt.
